name: Merchant & Maiden café pizza bar
address: 2 Kerk Street, Hoekwil, Wilderness, 6538, South Africa
description_short: Artisan pizza and café fare in Hoekwil's historic church building, just minutes from Wilderness beaches.
description_long:
Housed in a beautifully restored church on Hoekwil's main street, Merchant & Maiden café pizza bar brings warmth and character to this small village between George and Wilderness. The high ceilings and original architectural details create an unexpectedly charming backdrop for wood-fired pizzas, proper coffee, and all-day café classics.

The menu focuses on quality ingredients done well — think crispy-based pizzas with inventive toppings, hearty breakfast plates, and freshly baked goods. It's the kind of neighbourhood spot that works equally for a lazy Saturday brunch or casual Friday night pizza and wine. The relaxed vibe attracts locals and visitors who've discovered this gem tucked away from the N2.

Just a five-minute drive from Wilderness's main beaches and lagoon, Merchant & Maiden makes an ideal stop whether you're exploring the Garden Route or simply craving honest food in a space with soul. The converted church setting adds unexpected charm to what could easily be your new favourite local.
